description: This PHP source file defines the 'EmployeeReport' class within the OrangeHRM Time Module. It handles report generation for employee hours, including filter preparation, validation, access control, and report header definition. Key features include request parameter handling, validation rules, permission checks, and report structuring logic.

classes.name: EmployeeReport
classes.description: This class represents an employee time report generator within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It manages filter preparation, validation rules, access control, and report header structure for employee time tracking data. Implements the EndpointAwareReport interface, utilizing traits for user role and localization helpers, and interacts with project and activity entities.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filter parameters from the request, including employee number, project ID, activity ID, date range, and timesheet status, returning a populated FilterParams object.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters such as employee number, project ID, activity ID, date range, and timesheet state, including custom callback validation for date logic.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the employee report based on their role and data group permissions; throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the report header with columns for project name, activity name, and duration, utilizing localization helpers for column names.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty filter definition object for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Generates and returns the employee report data based on provided filter parameters.
